༄༅/ /seng gdong ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// seng gdong ma'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so//

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs mchi zhing*// 'gro ba'i don du byang chub bsgrub/ oṃ swa bhā ba= rang sems hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las// steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad kun// gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang*// rgya gram mkha' 'gro gri gug dang*// phur pa dgra st+wa kha ṭwāṃ dang*// ral gri me dpung 'bar ba'i gur// bar mtshams las byed mkha' 'gros gang*// bar chad dgra bgegs thal bar brlag /de dbus gnam lcags sgo med mkhar// gru bzhi me dpung tshwa tshwa 'phro// de nang gnam lcags mchod rten dbus// gser gyi rdo rje'i lte ba ru// nyi zla'i nang du 'od lnga'i gur// de dbus chos 'byung pad nyi ro yi steng*// rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro sku mdog mthing*// seng zhal dkar khro spyan gsum g.yu ral sngo// gri thod kha ṭwāṃ bsnams shing gar stabs 'gying*// rdor khrab dur khrod chas brgyad dar nag gsol// phung khams skye mched ba spu mkha' 'gros gtams// gnas gsum 'bru gsum hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs te// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur// dbang lhas dbang bskur mi bskyod rgyas gdab pa'i// thugs kar nyi steng 'khor lo'i lte bar hūm̐// bcu bzhi'i rtsibs steng sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor// aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ arghaṃ sogs/ dpal ldan rdo rje lha mo ni// sogs bstod pa gang rung bya/ rtsibs nang dkar mo stong gis nang gzigs srung*// gnas gsum 'od kyis 'khor 'das mthu byin bsdus// bsrung bya la thim gzi brjid nus mthu rgyas// aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥphaṭaḥ rtsibs nang nag mo stong gis phyir gzigs zlog /gzugs snang mkha' 'gro sgra grags bcu bzhi pa// srid gsum g.yo 'gul dregs pa sngangs shing brgyal// las byed mkha' 'gros byad ma lha srung bkug /mtshon cha'i bar bskyur mtshon cha g.yon du 'khor// sha khrag phye mar song ba mkha' 'gros gsol// mthe bong zangs gri mdzub mo gtan pa'i bar// dgra mgo bregs pa hom nang gshin rjes mid// lag g.yas nyi ma rtsibs stong me dpung 'bar// g.yon pas zla ba rtsibs stong chu bo 'brub// brdabs pas bcir bsregs bkrus thal gshin rjes zos//

sngags bcu bzhi sogs/ 'og phyogs bsad khang gru gsum me 'bar nang*// mkha' 'gros dgra bgegs bkug cing mtshon char phab// rnam shes nag thum bsad cing lus srog gtub// yaḥmaḥruḥṭaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥsodaḥsodaḥ rang lus rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi ldan pa'i// sum mdor nyi steng mkha' 'gro sor gang dmar// de las me byung spyi bo'i dkar mor phog /de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs dga' bzhi myong*// snod bcud hūm̐ thim de yang mi dmigs pa// stong gsal ye dwangs nyid de nam mkha' 'dra// dge bas 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog / ces pa 'di'i gzhung lugs man ngag yun ring du goms par byas pa karma a rā gas sbyar zhing rang gis kyang nyams su myong bar byas so/// / hrīḥhūm̐ bhyo zlog phaṭaḥyaḥraḥmaḥsaḥraḥdaḥshaḥtsaḥraḥmaḥsaḥkaḥ.aḥ ya ma ru ṭa sha da ra sa ma ra ya phaṭaḥsod sodaḥ e ka du na rakṣa/ ma hā du na rakṣa/ tsa dur snying na rakṣa/ tsa ra du na rakṣa/ su tri du na rakṣa/ ma ra du na rakṣa/ e ka du na zlog /ma hā du na zlog /tsa dur snying na zlog /ra tsa du na zlog /su tri du na zlog /ma ra du na zlog// /
